fit_reason: Private owner selling a whole boat, a 2000 Sea Ray 340 Sundancer, in the boats by owner section.
findings: Hull looks white and reasonably glossy in the on-water shots, but most photos are taken from a distance, so close-up gelcoat condition can't be judged
Transom and swim platform area in the slip photo look slightly dull and off-white compared with the rest of the hull
No interior or cabin photos, so cockpit and cabin condition can't be assessed
message: Hi, we saw your listing for the 340 Sundancer and it looks well kept on the water. In the slip photo the transom and swim platform look a little dull next to the rest of the hull, and a gelcoat polish and wax there would help the close-up shots buyers look at. We do pre-sale boat details and come to you at the slip. Would you like a quote?
